author: Unknown; Jewish tradition names Joshua
authorNote: Many scholars see Joshua to 2 Kings as one connected history, edited during or after the exile (6th century BC). Historians also debate how far the conquest accounts match archaeology.
date: Events c. 1400–1200 BC (dating debated); written later
overview: Joshua leads Israel across the Jordan into Canaan. The book tells of the fall of Jericho, the battles for the land, and how the land was divided among the tribes. It ends with Joshua challenging the people: "Choose this day whom you will serve."
storyPlace: Israel finally enters the land promised to Abraham.
